content: Hold on to truth, in this world there is so much that one can desire to have as an anchor for life, only those who have Jesus have a sure foundation for their soul's. Life can offer many solutions to issues one may go through, man has come up with philosophies and theories about the purpose or mean of life, but it's all about Jesus and the Life He gave! He is the Way the Truth and the Life!

The things on Earth are a shadow of what Heaven holds, the reality of blessing and fulfilment is Heaven. Many people have seen Heaven to be the reward of being a Christian but the truth is revealed to us from Scripture, Heaven is available to us Now! We are already citizens of Heaven, we have the Keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, we are already Joint Heirs with Christ. We have been raised together with Christ and are seated in Heavenly places! Walk in Heavens blessing Now!

The safety place for your dreams is Faith, doubt and fear are out there trying to steal even the best of ideas that you have. You are only as big as the dreams you have, there is no position anyone can give you that was meant to satisfy you, but when you come into the reality of the God given Vision that He placed in your heart, you will be fulfilled. Have faith, it shall come to pass, only Believe.

Jesus didn't come for the righteous but sinners that He would make them righteous according to God's standard! Never lose the wonder of the fact that He is the one who makes us righteous not our deeds! It was the work of His will and Power! As you walk your Christian life be strong in this truth that it is His power that made you and continually makes you righteous before Him!

Worship is more than a song we sing, it is the devotion of the innermost part of man to God, the expression of love and reverence from the Spirit, Soul and Body! Even the inanimate objects of creation cry out in Worship, the very nature of God pulls out worship from within us. To authentically worship Him, one must get to know Him for themselves, not hear-say but a personal revelation. Who is He to you? Worship is only as real as you know Him!

There is a new season for you today, the Lord is calling you to a higher level, and greater experience! In the spirit a new season is a place, it's a new location of function, new angels coming around your life, you may not see it physically yet spiritually so much has changed! From this moment, live from the reality of the spirit, confess your new life, your new opportunities, your favor and blessings! Your levels have changed!

Jesus came that we may have life abundantly, in His death burial and Resurrection, He fulfilled all the requirements for this to be a reality for us! God just doesn't merely have good thoughts and desires for you, He paid such a high price to insure it would be rightfully yours, now all you have to do is thank Him for it and receive your Health, your prosperity, your freedom, your blessing! It's already been paid for!

Jesus is the solid rock of your life, in Him you stand strong and above all the ways and systems of the World. In His love God asks us to trust Him, because He doesn't put us through the problem, but He is the way of escape, in Him is permanent victory and surety! Your life in Christ is solid and strong, you shall not be shaken!

The decisions we make in Life are what in turn make us, a decision to mean to people makes one a mean person, a decision to steal makes one a thief, the decision to be kind and good to people makes you a good person. You are what you decide to be, life gives you options but it's up to you to take a path a walk that road! Chose to be the fullness of what God has placed in you! Be the best you, you have so much value, you are a man or woman of Purpose!

Who determines God's thoughts and ideas towards you? Many have placed their notions and ideas about life on God, they place human ways of forgiveness and love on God. But the revelation of the Bible tells us to love and forgive the way God does it. His standards are to become ours, we are to come up to His level, God has placed a divine ability in you to manifest His heart knows every place and situation.

There is a mindset of the righteous, we who are in Christ have a mindset, we have the knowledge of God so established in us that we filter everything through that lens. We are a people of the Word, out lives head in the direction and revelational experience of the Word. Victory and success are the hallmark of your lives. We are the just on the Earth.

What if what you fear doing is the very thing that is holding your breakthrough. Fear and doubt have kept so many people away from their purpose in life, there is so much that you will miss out by living in fear. Make it a point each day to challenge your comfort zone; reach out for the greatness that God has for you.

The primary person who hears God over your life is you, He then has a number of people come and confirm that word. As a believer God desires one on one fellowship with you! He knows how to talk to you, Open your heart to Him and allow Him guide you by His Spirit in you. There is no need to walk and be without direction. You will know exactly what to do next, no more trial and error!

Jesus brought life that breaks the Power it death, the life of Christ is not fragile. Life is more powerful than death, Light is stronger than darkness, health is greater than sickness, this is the Power of Christ! He defeated all powers and principalities and now He reigns permanently over them. The darkness cannot stand the Power of Christ in you!

There is no defeat in Christ, now in the natural when people give advice they say "you win some, you lose some" but that's not the reality for those who are in Christ. No matter what people experience, that doesn't change the Word of God! We are more than conquerors, we have victory and success in every endeavor. Line up your life to the reality of the Victory in Christ!

The Love of God is not passive, it is very active, He doesn't wait for you to find Him, He comes running to you, He seeks you out and fights for you! Before you ever made a decision for Him, He made a decision for you, to Love you and call you His own. Wherever you are today you can embrace His Love and walk in it!

Being joyful has nothing to do with that which occurs around you, it has everything to do with the Nature of righteousness within you! You are joyful by design the Lord has made you that way in Christ! Allow the Joy of the Lord to flow through you, it is a well you can draw from at anytime.

Life is Beautiful, it is a gift from God, take time to enjoy the beautiful of the things that God has given you, great friendships, great weather, tasty food etc. God has made all this available to us, and the more you are thankful for things that matter the more you see everything around you begins to grow and produce more, what you appreciate appreciates.

The Blessing of the Lord makes rich, there is a blessed life that is available to you in Christ. You don't even have to apologize for it. Jesus paid for you to have an abundant life, fill with Joy and fulfilment, don't accept anything less, rejoice and receive all that is yours in Christ!

Hold on to what is true no matter what the circumstances around you say. The Word of God is Truth, the Word is unfailing and unchanging you can build your life on it, where many miss it is that the try the natural way of doing things and when things go off they then run to God! Get the Word from the onset stay with the wisdom of God!

The eyes of the Lord are upon you for Good! The Lord is watching over His Word to perform it in your life. Every Word that the Lord has spoken in your life is not merely to excite you, but to bring it to pass. You are the place of fulfilment, when the Lord wants to show off the Manifestation of His Word He shows you off to creation.

Spirituality will always impact the natural world, because everything natural is a off shoot of a spiritual stem. The culture, economy, health etc, are all affected by the Spiritual. God has sent us here to be Heavens ambassadors to the Earth to Bring forth Heavens reality in all the concerns us. We are the Conduit of Heaven's blessing to the Earth.

The Glory of the latter house shall be greater than the former. This reality is true about your life and all that concerns you, the Lord is taking you from Glory to Glory! Never will there be a point in your life where your best days are behind you, your Journey with the Lord is from strength to strength. You haven't seen anything yet, the best is yet to come.

When called upon to manifest Faith in your daily life, no believer should ever back down. The sheer fact that you are a believer denotes that you believe what is impossible by natural circumstances. The life of every person we see the Bible was nothing short of supernatural, as a believer you have an edge above the natural way of life, Miracles happen as the order of your day!

In the Gospels we see Jesus and His love for people, how He healed and restored them, His words were life giving and whoever came to Him received life and was completely changed by the power of God! Now the Bible tells us that we are the body of Christ, therefore we are to manifest Christ; to be His hands and feet, to speak words that Heal and bless. Your world should not feel the absence of Jesus because you are there, you are the light of the world.

Be thankful for where you are now, rejoice in all that the Lord has done and how far you have come, but do not settle here. Do get comfortable there is yet more to be done, greater things to be achieved. Celebrate where you are now, then lift your eyes to something greater in the will of God. There is more; this current situation is not a destination.

The Power of Change is in one's ability to note that Christ is the Change that they need. Changing oneself will stress and work you to discouragement. When it comes to bringing about change in one's life, it's not about how much you can hold on and press into it; it's about letting go, surrendering to the person of the Holy Spirit and allowing Him to Change you inside out. The change He gives is permanent.

You are here to show forth the Glory of the Lord. It's every believers desire for the Lord to be Manifested in their lives, we desire to see Him glorified in Us, here is what that looks like, when the Lord is manifested in you, your health is His Health, your strength is He strength, your wealth is His wealth!! This is more than asking the Lord to give you something, but it is a place where you manifest His life and nature in All that concerns you.

The counsel of the Lord stands forever, there is divine wisdom that the Lord has given us to walk in, He will never leave you stranded in any area of your life. The Lord desires to Guide and bring you to a place of security and surety. There is a way to succeed in business, in academia, in marriage etc. God has provided success for you by the leading of the Holy Spirit, receive His counsel today.

The Love of God is the Hallmark of the Christian faith, it is the reason for salvation, the Power that keeps us saved and the pursuit for every believer. One should never relegate the Love of God to a display of weakness, the spiritual maturity and stance of a believer is judged by their Love walk. Those who know God walk in Love, it is the Greatest strength of anyone who desires to know the Lord at a deep level.

The Lord has given you strength to overcome whatever seem to be weighing you down, there is nothing that is impossible with God! That struggle can be broken, there is power that can raised Jesus from the dead, there is power that broke sins hold off men, there is power that raised the people out of poverty to prosperity. All things are Possible, all that He asks for is that we believe, the Power is available; call upon the omnipotent God and He shall show Himself strong in your life and situation.

The Lord is very intentional about those that are weak and in need of Help. There is a mentality that many have of the Lord being offended with those who are struggling or not where they are supposed to be, however the Lord wants to lift up and restore, He has a heart for those who humble themselves before Him, He will not let you fall, He is full of love! He never gives up on you.

The Holy Spirit loves to guide you, it is His job and privilege to make you a wonder, there is no case that is beyond Him. Your life is in line to became a success story. He is the best coach and guide, the best leader and teacher. He is an expert in taking the worst of things and making the best! From the Beginning of the Earth He brooded on the waters and caused light to come out of darkness, so shall He do in your life.

Jesus makes all His associates Kings, you cannot come around Him long enough and remain in a beggarly kind of life. Look at Heaven, everything surrounding God is glorious, streets of Gold, elaborate buildings with extreme attention to detail; Yet the revelations from the Word reveals to us that He is more concerned about us, than for beauty of creation. You are called to reign in life, refuse anything less.

Jesus won't let you down, He never fails or gives up; He follows through to the end. The worst thing anyone can do is quit on Jesus, because He remains faithful at all times when we are faithless He is faithful. In those moments of losing hope all you can do is reach out for Him and hold on to His Love for you, even when words are few He hears the cry of the heart. He will never let you down. He is near to all who call upon Him, trust Him today.

Don't let your feelings control your spiritual decisions, Faith is not a matter of feelings, faith is based on the Word of God that one hears and believes. Your spiritual life is based on what you believe in line with God's Word. You cannot feel like a Christian, you have to believe that you are, and receive the witness of the Spirit. We don't feel blessed, we believe and know that we are based in God's Word. Walk in the reality and counsel of the Word of God, you are who He says you are!

God is Perfect in all that He does, whenever you see God hand on a thing His signature is perfection. If any area of your life is not yet experiencing it, that Goes it show that the Lord still has something to do there. Don't settle for just Good, God did not make you to survive and get through life, you are called to be the light and to shine all round.

The world is searching and looking for help, everyone seems to be reaching towards something, sadly in the end they realize that it doesn't satisfy. The Hope of the World is the Church, we are the ones to whom God has entrusted the answers, we are called to shine in the fullness of what the Lord has given us. We are the Light of the World.

Jesus does not give any second chances, His blood resets us back to the beginning. Justification in Christ is being brought to a place where, you are not the one who committed the crimes, because Jesus took the punishment that our sins deserved, so God does not give a second chance, every chance in God is the first. You are blameless in Christ!

To make significant progress, live a focussed life, it may be hard to consistently focus on something you want to achieve in 5 years, but take life one day at a time, do the things that you need to do today to achieve that Big dream that you have. The Lord guides us in making progress and allows us to enjoy life every day, time is a vehicle that takes us to the destination we keep our eyes and focus on. We are a people of Vision.

The Lord is looking for people to reign with Him, not just those who will be crying out to Him for what they need, but a people raised and trained to reign. As a believer you are to graduate and become a dispenser of blessings, the goal of Christianity is not just to make it to Heaven, rather it is to manifest Sons of God and bring Heaven down to Earth!

What you believe about God will define your experience of life, let Jesus be your definition of what life is, Jesus is Truth, He brings all things into true light. The true reality of things are what they are in Christ, as a believer our Faith is in the reality of all that Jesus has done for us. The life that was purchased at the cross is our reality, that's our truth!

You are a man or woman of Faith, as believers Faith is what we live by. Thoughts of doubt and fear may come to your mind, but we do not dwell on them, that a thought of doubt comes to your mind doesn't not mean you are in doubt, it's just the devil giving you the opportunity to doubt, don't take the thought rather speak Faith, speak the Word of God. Your life will head in the direction of your words, therefore speak Faith and not your feelings, be a Word speaker.

God is relational, He made us to have relationships with each other, relationships that flow in all directions; upwards i.e with those above us to learn from, those besides us encourage and enjoy company with, then those below us to inspire and lift up. No one was born to do life on their own, God has placed something for you in others and there is something in you that others need, you need to give us much as you receive. Live conscious of the blessing around you and the blessing you are to others.

Meekness is power under control, being humble has nothing to do with weakness, but rather the choice to bring Glory to God through your life, by accepting who you are and being confident about it while giving due honor to those above you being a blessing to all that you are called to. A humble person can never be intimidated, He or she is secure in who they are that they can celebrate those who are gifted differently.

To be a believer is of grand significant. In the realm of the spirit what you believe is your reality, if you don't believe that there are angels assigned to protect you, you will not experience their protection. What you believe is your reality, you are going to Heaven because you believe in Jesus Christ. All things are possible with God, and all things are possible to him that believes; Believing brings you into the class of God.

The state of your heart is what will flow out of you, if you allow offence and hatred in your heart, it will beginning to flow from you, fill your heart with Noble things; life giving thoughts and words, as you go throughout life that is what will come out of you! Be a well of life to all those around you a place where others come and draw from the waters of Joy and Peace. This is the nature of the Spirit of God in you.

Jesus needs your hands and feet to fulfil He purpose on the Earth, You are the Word in motion, the promises of God to people take place when God raises a man or woman to Walk out the Word. When you love those that are broken, they feel the arms of Jesus wrapping around them, when you lay hands on the sick, Jesus provides the power, we provide the action in the physical. Be His hands and feet today, be a blessing to those around you!

God never meant for you to react to life, or live your whole life doing damage control. The enemy has kept many people busy putting out fires in their lives that they never live out their full purposes. Take action in your life, make progress in the direction of your Call and Destiny. Light was meant to be seen, and by nature Light is an influencer, Jesus made you and I the Light, that means we don't adjust to life, but rather Life adjusts to us.

Prayer is an invitation from the Monarchy of the Universe, to have a closed door meeting and private fellowship. It's the highest honor in existence you need to consider it very seriously, what a privilege to be known and called by God Almighty. Interaction with Majesty affects the nature around you, it changes your mindset, it sharpens you to spiritual realities and the experience of victory.
